The '''Österreichische Gesellschaft für Operations Research''' ('''ÖGOR''') ('''Austrian Society of Operations Research''') is the professional non-profit society for the scientific field of [[Operations Research]] in [[Austria]]. The society, founded in 1978, is recognized by the [[International Federation of Operational Research Societies]] and its subgrouping, the [[Association of European Operational Research Societies]], as the main national society for Operations Research in its country.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=EURO - The Association of European Operational Research Societies - Austria |url=https://www.euro-online.org/web/ms/1/Austria |access-date=2026-02-16 |website=www.euro-online.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Cochran |first=James J. |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/book/10.1002/9780470400531 |title=Wiley Encyclopedia of Operations Research and Management Science |last2=Cox |first2=Louis A. |last3=Keskinocak |first3=Pinar |last4=Kharoufeh |first4=Jeffrey P. |last5=Smith |first5=J. Cole |date=2011-01-07 |publisher=Wiley |isbn=978-0-470-40063-0 |edition=1 |language=en |doi=10.1002/9780470400531.eorms0070}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Austria |url=https://www.ifors.org/austria/ |access-date=2026-02-16 |website=www.ifors.org |language=en}}</ref>

{{As of|2026}}, the President of ÖGOR is [[Ulrich Pferschy]].<ref name=":0" />

== Publications ==
ÖGOR publishes a scientific journal, the ''Central European Journal of Operations Research'' (CEJOR), which is published by [[Springer Publishing|Springer]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=2026 |title=Central European Journal of Operations Research |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/10100 |access-date=2026-02-16 |website=SpringerLink |language=en}}</ref> The current Editor-in-Chief of CEJOR is the former ÖGOR president [[:de:Ulrike Leopold-Wildburger|Ulrike Leopold-Wildburger]].<ref name=":1" /> Furthermore, the ÖGOR News are published once or twice a year containing news about the society.

== Awards ==
Every year ÖGOR awards an award for both the best Masters Thesis as well as the best PhD Thesis in the field of Operations Research in Austria.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024 |title=Master's thesis award of the Austrian Society for Operations Research 2024 |url=https://www.jku.at/en/institute-of-business-analytics-and-technology-transformation/news-events/current-news-events/detail/news/oegor-masterarbeitspreis-2024/}}</ref>
